methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Cause and Effect Linking
content: Problem: Students know weather words and clothing words, but struggle to connect them logically using conjunctions like "so".

Solution: This week introduces the logical bridge "so" (vì vậy) to connect a weather condition (Cause) with a clothing choice (Effect). We combine the Present Continuous for weather ("It is raining") with the Present Continuous for personal state ("I am wearing"). TPR involves looking up at the "sky", declaring the weather, and physically acting out putting on the corresponding clothing item.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show a "rain" card. Student says: "It is raining, so I am holding an umbrella."
S2 pull-out: Show a "windy" card. Student says: "It is windy, so I am wearing a hat."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A has the weather. Student B has the clothes. They must match them using "so".

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W17: raining, snowing, sunny, cloudy, windy
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (raining, snowing, sunny, cloudy, windy) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: "It is V-ing" + "so" + "I am wearing..." (Cause/Effect)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: "It is V-ing" + "so" + "I am wearing..." (Cause/Effect).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "The World Around Us — Weather Mission"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "The World Around Us — Weather Mission".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (raining, snowing, sunny, cloudy, windy usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
